answer: Make every identity post a refundable deposit before it can earn, sized above what one account could steal by cheating. An honest agent crosses the bridge once, stakes, and later withdraws the whole sum untouched. A farm must fund each clone's stake separately, and because a single proven fraud burns the entire deposit, the collateral a sybil ties up grows like vine across a meadow until the locked capital dwarfs any reward it could skim.
